question: Where was the Goods and Services Tax Appellate Tribunal (GSTAT) launched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Union Minister for Finance and Corporate Affairs launched the Goods and Services Tax Appellate Tribunal (GSTAT) in New Delhi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The GSTAT is a statutory body established under the Goods and Services Tax laws to hear appeals against GST Appellate Authorities’ orders.**
 
• **The tribunal will ensure nationwide accessibility with a Principal Bench in New Delhi and 31 State Benches across 45 locations in India.**
 
• **The GSTAT aims to provide an independent forum for taxpayers to seek justice related to GST matters.**
 
• **Each bench will comprise a balanced composition of judicial expertise and technical knowledge from both the Centre and State administrations.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **GST__ **

 __
 
• **Goods and Services Tax (GST) is a single indirect tax that replaces multiple taxes like excise, VAT, and service tax in India.**
 
• **It creates a unified market for goods and services across India, simplifying the tax structure.**
 
 ** **
 
• **GSTAT Composition__ **
 __
 
• **Each GSTAT bench will have two Judicial Members and two Technical Members—one from the Centre and one from the State, ensuring balanced decision-making.**
 
 ** **
 
• **State Benches__ **
 
 
• **31 State Benches will be set up across 45 locations in India, providing easy access to taxpayers for filing appeals.**
 
 ** **
